author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
"I want to do decoupage on old hotel style furniture with old torn comic pages. What are my basic first steps? I'm supremely new to this." "I am looking to build a concrete life size statue of a weeping angel from Dr. Who but I have never worked with concrete before. Any suggestions?" "When you started in visual effects did you ever think that you would become a mentor on such a high level in the industry?" In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers these questions from Tested members truedadof2  and akeladraconis, whom we thank for their support!
